text: Implement the custom completion in Go with `ValidArgsFunction` for arguments and `RegisterFlagCompletionFunc` for flags; these are portable across Bash, Zsh, Fish, and PowerShell (`site/content/completions/_index.md:477-479`). Shell scripts request results through the hidden `__complete` or `__completeNoDesc` commands (`completions.go:25-34`), instead of relying on Zsh-specific or legacy Bash scripting.
